name: finite-dimensional physical gap certificate
statement: For a finite residual basis h_a with physical Gram matrix G_ab=<h_a,h_b>_F, Dq Jacobian J_ia=Dq_i[h_a], and positive weight matrix W, the squared gap is sigma_0^2=lambda_min(G^{-1/2} J^T W J G^{-1/2}). If this minimum is positive then C_HDq=1/sigma_0.
guard: Requires numeric/source-backed G, J, W rows.

name: projector certificate check
statement: For a candidate projector matrix P on the same basis, check ||P^2-P||=0 and ||J P||=0. Rank(P)=nullity(J) then certifies range(P)=ker(J).
guard: Requires numeric/source-backed P and J rows.

name: notation guard
statement: The string Pi_kerDq is not enough. Until P or an equivalent operator definition is supplied, the route has only H_q annihilation and Hperp splitting, not eta_Dq_kernel=0.
